reason: The pilot terms are fair and I like that my volunteers don't do double work, but we're a 1,350-member club with 27 holes and a working system; I'm not betting that on two founders whose first club isn't even live yet. I'd put it on the list for spring and look again once Zwolle has results.
objection: Two people supporting a club our size: who picks up the phone on a Saturday in May when the tee sheet is full and something breaks? And the weekly copy from our current system sounds like it depends on our current supplier cooperating.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Zwolle's results page after a full season and hearing from their board that the bar tab, invoices and the SEPA file worked without extra evening work for the desk.
